method.text: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, half the garlic, salt and pepper; roll into meatballs and brown.
Soften the onion and remaining garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and oregano, simmer with the meatballs 30 min.
Boil the spaghetti, toss with sauce, finish with parmesan.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then whisk in the milk gradually; melt in the cheddar to make a smooth cheese sauce.
Boil the macaroni, fold through the cheese sauce, top with breadcrumbs and bake until bubbling.
Cream butter and sugars, beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt, then the chopped dark chocolate; bake in spoonfuls at 375°F for 11 min.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a dry mix.
Whisk 1 cup dry mix with buttermilk, eggs and melted butter; griddle in pools until bubbling.

ingredients.item: whole San Marzano tomatoes, for the sauce

method.text: Mix the 00 flour, water, instant yeast and salt; knead and prove 6 hours.
Crush the tomatoes for the sauce, top the stretched dough with sauce, mozzarella and basil; bake as hot as the oven goes.
Brown the beef, stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas and build with cheese, diced tomato, lettuce, onion and salsa.
Whisk garlic, anchovy, egg yolk, lemon juice and zest, then stream in the oil.
Toss the chopped romaine with dressing, croutons from the bread, and grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and zest and salt.
Fold in finely diced red onion, cilantro, jalapeno and garlic.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add chili powder, cumin, crushed tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 1 hour.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs and mashed bananas.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt and walnuts; bake in a loaf tin at 350°F for 55 min.
Cut the butter into the flour with salt and ice water; chill, then roll two pie crusts.
Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon and cornstarch, fill the crust, top with the second pie crust and bake at 400°F.
Warm the cream, butter and garlic.
Toss the cooked fettuccine through with grated Parmigiano Reggiano and black pepper.
Butter the bread, fill with cheese, and griddle until golden and molten.
Form and season 4 patties; sear hard on both sides, melting a slice of cheese on each.
Build on toasted buns with tomato, onion, lettuce and ketchup.
Boil the peeled potatoes until tender.
Mash with warm milk and butter; season with salt.
Rub the chicken with butter, salt and pepper; stuff with lemon, garlic and fresh thyme.
Roast at 425°F until the juices run clear, about 75 min.
Sear the chuck, then soften onion and garlic with tomato paste.
Deglaze with red wine, add hot beef stock and vegetables, braise 3 hours.
Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, milk, onion, Worcestershire and salt; press into a loaf.
Glaze with ketchup and bake at 375°F for 55 min.
Marinate the chicken thighs in seasoned buttermilk overnight.
Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 350°F until deep golden and cooked through.
Brown the beef with garlic and simmer in the tomato sauce.
Mix ricotta with egg and parmesan; layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella; bake 45 min.
Soften shallots and garlic in butter, toast the rice, deglaze with white wine.
Ladle in warm vegetable broth until creamy; fold through mushrooms and Parmigiano-Reggiano.
Stir the ground spices into a spice blend.
Marinate the chicken in yogurt and half the spice blend; sear.
Soften onion, garlic and ginger with the rest of the spice blend, add crushed tomatoes and cream, simmer the chicken through.
Soak the rice noodles; whisk tamarind and fish sauce into a sauce.
Stir-fry tofu, shrimp and egg, add noodles and sauce, finish with sprouts, peanuts, scallions and lime zest.
Render the pancetta, brown the floured beef, soften garlic with tomato paste.
Deglaze with red wine, add beef broth, carrots and pearl onions; braise 3 hours, adding mushrooms at the end.
Soften pepper, tomato and garlic in olive oil; toast the rice with saffron.
Add hot chicken broth and chorizo, then nestle in the shrimp and mussels; do not stir, let the socarrat form.
Whisk yolks and sugar over a bain-marie, fold in the mascarpone.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso spiked with Grand Marnier, layer with the cream, dust with cocoa and chill.
Simmer the pork belly, build a broth with chicken broth, miso, garlic and ginger.
Cook the noodles, add soft-boiled eggs, sliced pork and scallions.
Make a dough with bread flour, instant yeast, warm milk, sugar and salt; chill.
Laminate with the butter block through three folds, shape and prove, then bake at 400°F.
Stir bourbon, Campari and sweet vermouth over ice; strain over a big cube and express the orange zest.
Shake vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso and simple syrup hard over ice; strain into a coupe.
Toast the black pepper, cook the pasta, and emulsify with pecorino romano, butter and starchy water into a glossy sauce.
Bloom the active dry yeast in warm milk with sugar.
Mix into a soft dough with bread flour, butter, egg and salt; prove, shape into rolls, prove again and bake.
Poach the chicken breast in the broth, shred it back in.
Simmer carrots, celery, onion and garlic; add the pasta and cook until tender.
